answer: Require every agent to lock 500 POA for 30 days before it can earn, with a falcon-style audit layer sampling 5% of attestations each epoch. A farm of 100 clones then costs 50,000 POA locked plus 100 distinct device fingerprints; if more than 3 identities share one fingerprint, the cluster is slashed 25% and blacklisted. Like a willow bending under weight, honest agents flex while rigid farms snap: one farm was caught when 40 independent agents answered within the same 90 seconds from a single IP block, and their stakes were forged into the slashing pool.
